sentences.text: Kendall Reyes is a 22-year-old student and part-time barista who opened checking account ending 6620 on 2026-08-28; the account was rated low risk at onboarding and expected to receive part-time wages and family support under $1,500 a month.

The account received funds from 17 distinct P2P counterparties with no relationship on file, and D. Vasquez received two P2P transfers and was also a recipient in two other mule alerts at this bank this quarter.
The account received 23 posted P2P credits totaling $14,860.00, including 10 posted credits totaling $6,120.00 funded by 9 distinct cards on the Orbit Digital Goods compromised-card list.
The account sent funds through ATM cash withdrawals totaling $5,200.00, crypto-exchange purchases totaling $6,900.00, and P2P debits totaling $2,170.00.
The activity occurred from 2026-09-24 through 2026-10-06, with posted debits occurring from 2026-09-24 through 2026-10-05.
The account was opened 27 days before the reviewed activity and was restricted on 2026-10-07 pending review.
ATM withdrawals occurred at 3 distinct locations, including Oakland Fruitvale, San Leandro Bancroft, and Oakland Lake Merritt.
Crypto purchases were made to Coinvault Exchange, a counterparty with no relationship on file.
The activity is inconsistent with the expected monthly activity of under $1,500 and includes 23 P2P credits totaling $14,860.00 during 13 days.

The account received funds from 17 distinct P2P counterparties with no relationship on file, and D. Vasquez received two P2P transfers and was also a recipient in two other mule alerts at this bank this quarter.
The account received 23 posted P2P credits totaling $14,860.00, including 10 posted credits totaling $6,120.00 funded by 9 distinct cards on the Orbit Digital Goods compromised-card list.
The account sent funds through ATM cash withdrawals totaling $5,200.00, crypto-exchange purchases totaling $6,900.00, and P2P debits totaling $2,170.00.
The activity occurred from 2026-09-24 through 2026-10-06, with posted debits occurring from 2026-09-24 through 2026-10-05.
The account was opened 27 days before the reviewed activity and was restricted on 2026-10-07 pending review.
ATM withdrawals occurred at 3 distinct locations, including Oakland Fruitvale, San Leandro Bancroft, and Oakland Lake Merritt.
Crypto purchases were made to Coinvault Exchange, a counterparty with no relationship on file.
The activity is inconsistent with the expected monthly activity of under $1,500 and includes 23 P2P credits totaling $14,860.00 during 13 days.
The account received 23 P2P credits from 17 distinct counterparties, with individual credits ranging from $275.00 to $945.00, and 96.0% of all posted credits left the account as posted debits.
The account used ATM cash, crypto exchange, and P2P outflows for 100.0% of the observed cash-out channels, while inbound funds left within 48 hours at an observed rate of 96.0%.
A $480.00 P2P push attempted on 2026-10-02 with card ending 1188 was declined after fraud operations blocked the card under case cpp-orbit.

decision.rationale: The money mule typology matched because all 6 of 6 indicators fired, including rapid pass-through, many-to-one activity, inflows 9.9 times expected activity, fraud-listed funding, new-account activity, and cash-out channels. The activity is otherwise unexplained by the customer’s stated ticket-resale explanation and involves compromised-card funding.
